description: This Rust source file implements gRPC server methods for a DataBroker, including get, set, subscribe, and get_server_info, handling data retrieval, updates, subscriptions, and server info responses with detailed error handling and permission checks.

classes.name: broker::DataBroker
classes.description: Implements the gRPC server interface for data operations, including get, set, subscribe, and server info.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles data retrieval requests, processes requested entries with regex matching, permission checks, and returns matching data entries or errors.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Handles data update requests, validates entries, permissions, and applies updates, returning success or detailed errors.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, validates patterns, permissions, and returns a stream of updates or errors.

methods.name: get_server_info
methods.description: Returns server information including name and version.
